questions.stem:
Practice form 3.
Which check is most important before accepting a real-world model?
A) Ignore negative or impossible outputs.
B) Assume every graph is linear.
C) Confirm units, constraints, and assumptions match the situation.
D) Remove all contextual information.

options.A: Ignore negative or impossible outputs.
options.C: Confirm units, constraints, and assumptions match the situation.

questions.explanation: A valid model must respect units and realistic constraints.
